label: Climate Agri-Finance Stress Test
description: Climate stress-testing for agricultural and smallholder lending portfolios. Run drought, flood and yield-shock scenarios, project portfolio-at-risk under climate stress, model an index-insurance overlay, and adapt NGFS-style scenarios for agri-MFIs.

claudeKnowledge.description: NGFS climate scenarios (Phase V, 2024); IPCC AR6 regional projections; FAO and IFAD agricultural-finance guidance; CGAP smallholder-finance research; IAIS index-insurance papers; national meteorological / agro-climatic data; Basel Committee climate-risk principles (BCBS, June 2022).

guidedInputs.label: Lender Type
guidedInputs.description: What kind of institution holds the agricultural lending book under test?

guidedInputs.label: Geography / Agro-Climatic Zone
guidedInputs.description: Where is the portfolio exposed? Select the dominant agro-climatic zone(s).

guidedInputs.label: Dominant Crops / Value Chains
guidedInputs.description: Which crops or value chains dominate the agricultural book? Drives yield-shock sensitivity.

guidedInputs.label: Stress Scenarios to Run
guidedInputs.description: Which climate-stress scenarios should the test cover? Map onto NGFS-style narratives where relevant.

options.label: Heat-stress yield shock (chronic / Hot House World)

guidedInputs.label: Index-Insurance Overlay
guidedInputs.description: Is a parametric / index-insurance overlay in place or being modelled? Drives the risk-transfer leg of the test.

options.label: Modelling a new overlay (not yet in place)

guidedInputs.label: Known Concerns, Data & Prior Losses
guidedInputs.description: Describe known concentrations, prior climate-driven loss events, data limitations, basis-risk experience, or supervisory expectations.
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. 2023 short-rains failure drove PAR30 from 4% to 19% in two branches; index payout under-triggered (basis risk); we have no geocoded loan locations; supervisor has asked for a climate scenario annex to the 2026 ICAAP...

exampleInput: We are an MFI in Kenya with a KES 850M agricultural book (~14,000 active smallholder borrowers) concentrated in semi-arid eastern counties. The book is mostly maize and mixed smallholder, single rainfed season, with a small dairy / pastoral sub-portfolio. After the 2022-2023 short-rains failure our PAR30 on the agri book spiked from about 5% to 22% in the worst branches and we restructured a large share of loans. We have a pilot weather-index insurance overlay on roughly 30% of the book but borrowers complained it did not pay out in a year they clearly lost their crop. We have loan-level data but no reliable geocoding of farms. Run a climate stress test: model 1-in-10 and 1-in-25 drought, a heat-stress yield shock, and a compound drought-plus-price scenario; show projected portfolio-at-risk and expected credit loss under each; assess how much the index overlay actually absorbs (net of basis risk); and frame it against NGFS-style scenarios for a climate annex our regulator now expects.

exampleValues.known_concerns: 2022-2023 short-rains failure pushed agri PAR30 from ~5% to ~22% in worst branches; large restructuring round. Pilot weather-index overlay on ~30% of book under-triggered in a clear loss year (basis risk complaints). Loan-level data exists but farms are not geocoded. Regulator now expects a climate scenario annex in the ICAAP.
